title: status
description: Retained heartbeat. On connect the node registers an MQTT last will {schema_version, node_id, online: false}, which the broker publishes if the node drops. That last-will message has no ts, so ts is optional here.
x-rate: every 10 s, and the last will on disconnect

time_synced.description: Clock synchronised with the station. The fog-front tracker ignores nodes that are not.

buffered_msgs.description: Messages waiting in the offline buffer.
